mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy. This is a continuous signal without threshold activation.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS shows a positive correlation with 20-day forward returns (i.e., higher FEDFUNDS predicts higher returns) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth concerns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market stress regime defined by declining housing starts (HOUST) and rising residential sales (RSAFS), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 days due to concerns about a housing market correction and its impact on consumer spending.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1250 and RSAFS > 460000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 245.0 signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to anticipated monetary policy tightening and reduced equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 245.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, reflecting weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth potential.
failure_condition: INDPRO level shows a positive correlation with 20-day forward returns (i.e., lower INDPRO does not predict negative returns) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250 units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to reduced consumer confidence and potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1250 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and GDPC1 is weak, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
